id.description: Unique identifier for the header component

branding.description: Branding config. Flat: { title?, symbol?, logo?, alt? }. Responsive: { responsive: { base: {...}, lg: {...} } }. Theme-responsive: add symbolInverse/logoInverse to supply dark-shell artwork the theme swaps to.

navSections.description: Array of menu section objects with 'title', and mutually exclusive 'links' or 'href' properties

secondaryLinks.description: Array of secondary link objects with 'href' and 'text' properties

searchProps.description: (OPTIONAL) Configuration object for the search component

extended.description: Whether to use the extended header style

megamenu.description: Whether to use the megamenu style for navigation sections

useMenuIcon.description: Whether to use a menu icon instead of the word 'Menu'

stickyNav.description: Whether the navigation should become sticky when scrolling

utilityContent.description: Rendered inline, to the left of the search box (in both header variants).

navEndContent.description: Rendered right-justified, in line with the primary nav links (extended header only).
